CLM-PHOT-0139.statement: Under lossless metal substrate conditions, the maximum simulated absorptance achieved by the first-order SEP is at most 99.98%.

extra_quotes: In this work, we develop a semi-analytical matrix formulation in TM polarization to compute the optical response of a one-dimensional grating of ribbons of an anisotropic polarizable medium deposited at the interface between two dielectric media above a metallic substrate.
Convergence is reached for N = 50 in all results presented below, with convergence verified by monitoring the stability of the Fourier coefficients.

Fabrication disorder, such as edge roughness or fluctuations of the period, is expected to broaden the resonance, and a one-dimensional grating couples only to the field component perpendicular to the ribbons.
